provenance.semantic_review: researcher reviewed known-case consumer/providing paths; line-reference validation is not semantic proof
provenance.kimi_independent_candidate: separate pending artifact; not a source of this card

question: Does the architecture supply the target CPU SMT-group relation by the common first content consumption, rather than merely by online completion?

authority.level: consumer-supported interface interpretation, not a newly discovered written ABI norm
authority.condition: The selected interface denotes the target CPU own SMT group and the reviewed common core-starting path is active. Membership is not inferred for arbitrary sets or for_each_cpu loops.

required_configuration.note: Effective path/provider binding requires separate review; textual config declaration alone is not a full Kconfig/preprocessing proof. SCHED_SMT=y does not prove real SMT hardware exercised.

initialization_and_leader.possible_rq_object_binding: sched_init loop obtains cpu_rq(i) and assigns rq->core = rq; this ties the assignment to the object, without proving the entire outer boot sequence.
initialization_and_leader.initial_target_condition: Original line 5762 separately warns when target rq is not initially self; a membership result does not establish this value.
initialization_and_leader.singleton_branch: weight==1 exits before the other-leader search, even for a singleton that excludes target. No warning therefore cannot serve as the membership oracle.
initialization_and_leader.multi_member_condition: First leader search skips the target at 5770-5771. A different mask member with rq->core == rq is required for the later install path.
remaining_conditions: valid existing rq state for every member
ordering and synchronization across all content consumers

x86.eligibility: self/sibling topology setup in the reviewed complete function; online is later

s390.preparation: old smp_start_secondary notifies, then sets online, then updates masks
s390.eligibility: old cpu_thread_map excludes an offline target before setting self
s390.initial_storage: static storage starts zero, and early initialization/update exists; neither alone proves every later observed mask

common_deadline.path: notify_cpu_starting -> selected CPUHP callback -> sched_cpu_starting -> sched_core_cpu_starting -> sched_core_lock
common_deadline.requirement: Prepared by common content use, not by final online state. An offline target may already need valid topology.
common_deadline.scope: known initial-secondary-CPU path; no automatic proof of all dispatch, boot or hotplug executions

positions.relative_position: before local_irq_save; fields sampled separately, not one atomic mask event

reviewed_binding.target_argument_and_getter: bounded static binding for reviewed same target call chain; not measured pointer-address identity
reviewed_binding.separate_sample: usable only as observed_sample with independently reviewed origin/object evidence

evidence_levels.source_inference: source implementation and conditions, reviewed by researcher; not a formal normative source
evidence_levels.configuration: recorded selected projection, separate active-path review required
evidence_levels.archived_observation: specific run and sampling site only; not universal execution proof
evidence_levels.mock_assumption: declared local logical state, no real hardware reachability claim
evidence_levels.missing: insufficient, never negative evidence or automatic not_applicable
evidence_levels.model_candidate: independent suggestion to review, never silently promoted to researcher evidence

five_recorded_counterexamples.purpose: Distinguish membership, warning and leader conditions using already-recorded logical inputs, without treating all constructed states as real reachable kernels.

limits: Previously read s390/x86 case; not independent detection or generalization
Only explicit reviewed evidence and recorded values are evaluated; no arbitrary-C understanding is claimed
No exact consumption snapshot or concurrent writer proof
No new kernel boot, build or real SMT coverage
A satisfied narrow relation never produces whole-path PASS
Explicitly disabled selected path is not_applicable only for this card; fallback needs a separate review
